args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on `v2.3.1` across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to `v2.3.0` in all regions. The first rollback attempt hit a partial failure (only `us-east` completed), so I retried and confirmed all three regions (`us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`) are now on `v2.3.0`.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: `INC-0001` — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy", describing the rollback.

4. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.002.

Note: The incident creation initially returned a timeout, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that it was actually created (INC-0001, open).
